# Ideal Home

> Ideal Home is a leading UK home design, interior styling, and garden advice publication featuring budget-friendly shopping guides, expert tips, and curated high-street finds.

Published by Future PLC, Ideal Home combines practical home decor advice with accessible shopping recommendations and garden guidance. The site features contributions from interior stylists, garden experts, and shopping editors who highlight budget-friendly homeware and design inspiration.
